newsitem.title: USA: CBOE stock index options trading opens after delay.
newsitem.headline: CBOE stock index options trading opens after delay.

text.p: The Chicago Board Options Exchange (CBOE) delayed the opening of broad-based stock index options until 0838 CST/1438 GMT, a CBOE spokesman said on Wednesday.
The delay affected options on the S&P 100 .OEX, S&P500 .SPX and the Nasdaq 100 .NDX. indices.
In addition, some individual equity options, for example International Business Machines Corp's, were in a fast market. However, no individual equity options were being delayed, the spokeman said.
